# Experiment 1

```{r exp1-data, results = 'hide'}
exp1 <- read_csv("data/exp1.csv")
```

## Curiosity RT

```{r}
exp1 %>% 
  group_by(participant) %>% 
  summarise(
    curiosity_rt = mean(curiosity_rt, na.rm = T)
      ) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_curiosity_rt = mean(curiosity_rt),
    sd_curiosity_rt = sd(curiosity_rt)
  )
```

### Correlation with curiosity

Does time spent rating curiosity correlate with curiosity

```{r}
exp1 %>% 
  group_by(participant) %>% 
  summarise(estimate = cor(curiosity, curiosity_rt)) %>% 
  {t.test(.$estimate)}
```

## Curiosity rating

Mean time spent waiting, and curiosity frequency distribution, collapsed over participants and divided into 10 intervals, and the time spent at each curiosity level

```{r}
summarise(exp1, mean(choice_rt), sd(choice_rt))
exp1 %>% 
  mutate(
    curiosity_bin = cut(
      curiosity, 
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = .1),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) %>% 
  group_by(curiosity_bin) %>% 
  summarise(
    frequency = n(),
    mean_choice_rt = format(round(mean(choice_rt), 2), nsmall = 2),
    sd_choice_rt = format(round(sd(choice_rt), 2), nsmall = 2)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(mean_sd = glue("{mean_choice_rt} ({sd_choice_rt})")) %>% 
  select(-mean_choice_rt, -sd_choice_rt) %>% 
  write_csv("exp1-frequency.csv")
```

## Regression of time on curiosity

```{r}
fit_1_time <- lmer(
  choice_rt ~ curiosity_c + (curiosity_c | participant) + (1 | cue), 
  data = exp1
  )
summary(fit_1_time)
anova(fit_1_time)
exp1_p1 <- plot_model(fit_1_time, type = "eff", "curiosity_c")[[1]] + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1, 5)) +
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = "'Waiting' time (s)")
```

## Hint seeking

2 models: a. binomial of any hints, b. number of hints

```{r}
exp1 <- mutate(exp1, hints_any = as.numeric(hints > 0))
fit_1_hint_a <- glmer(
  hints_any ~ curiosity_c + (curiosity_c | participant) + (1 | cue),
  family = binomial(),
  data = exp1
)
summary(fit_1_hint_a)
anova(fit_1_hint_a)
exp1_p2 <- plot_model(fit_1_hint_a, type = "eff", "curiosity_c")[[1]] + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = "p(Asked for hint(s))")

fit_1_hint_b <- lmer(
  hints ~ curiosity_c + (curiosity_c | participant) + (1 | cue),
  data = exp1
)
summary(fit_1_hint_b)
anova(fit_1_hint_b)
exp1_p3 <- plot_model(fit_1_hint_b, type = "eff", "curiosity_c")[[1]] + 
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = "Number of hints requested")
```

## Time spent studying the answer

```{r}
summarise(exp1, mean(answer_rt), sd(answer_rt))
x <- lmer(
  answer_rt ~ curiosity_c + (curiosity_c | participant) + (1 | cue),
  data = exp1
)
summary(x)
anova(x)
```

## Final recall

```{r exp1-testmodel}
exp1 %>% 
  group_by(participant) %>% 
  summarise(recall = mean(test_accuracy, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  summarise(mean_recall = mean(recall), sd_recall = sd(recall))
fit_1_test <- glmer(
  test_accuracy ~ curiosity_c + (curiosity_c | participant) + (1 | cue),
  family = binomial(),
  data = exp1
)
summary(fit_1_test)
anova(fit_1_test)
exp1_p4 <- plot_model(fit_1_test, type = "eff", "curiosity_c")[[1]] + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = "p(Final recall)")
```

```{r exp1-fig, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3.4}
(exp1_p1 | exp1_p2 | exp1_p3 | exp1_p4) &
  labs(x = "Curiosity\n(centered)") &
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
ggsave("1.png", height = 3)
```

# Experiment 2

```{r exp2-data, results = 'hide'}
exp2 <- read_csv("data/exp2.csv") %>% 
  mutate(curiosity = factor(curiosity, levels = c("Not curious", "Curious"))) %>% 
  mutate(wait = choice_rt + continue_rt)
```

```{r}
prop.table(table(exp2$curiosity)) %>% round(2)
```

## Curiosity RT

```{r}
x <- exp2 %>% 
  group_by(curiosity, participant) %>% 
  summarise(
    curiosity_rt = mean(curiosity_rt, na.rm = T)
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = participant, names_from = curiosity, values_from = curiosity_rt)
summary(x)
t.test(x$Curious, x$`Not curious`, paired = T)
```

## Waiting time

```{r}
exp2_wt <- exp2 %>% 
  group_by(curiosity, participant) %>% 
  summarise(
    time = mean(wait, na.rm = T)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(curiosity) %>% 
  summarise(m = mean(time), sd = sd(time), n = n(), se = sd/sqrt(n))
exp2_wt
```


```{r exp2-timemodel}
fit_2_time <- lmer(
  wait ~ curiosity + (curiosity | participant) + (curiosity | cue),
  data = exp2
)
summary(fit_2_time)
anova(fit_2_time)
# exp2_p1 <- plot_model(fit_2_time, type = "eff", "curiosity")[[1]] + 
#   labs(title = "", x = "", y = "Time thinking of answer")
exp2_p1 <- exp2_wt %>% 
  ggplot(aes(curiosity, m)) +
  scale_y_continuous("'Waiting' time", expand = expansion(c(0, .2))) +
  scale_x_discrete("") +
  geom_col(fill = "gray80", col = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = m-se, ymax = m+se), width = .2)
```

# E3 vs E2

```{r}
names(exp2)
names(exp3)
dat <- bind_rows(exp2, exp3, .id = "experiment") %>% 
  mutate(experiment = as.factor(as.numeric(experiment)+1)) %>% 
  mutate(participant = paste(experiment, participant, sep = "_"))
```

## Waiting time

```{r}
fit_4_time <- lmer(

    (curiosity | participant) + (curiosity | cue),

)

anova(fit_4_time)
plot_model(fit_4_time, type = "int")
```

# What predicts recall

```{r}
x1 <- glmer(
  test_accuracy ~ hints_any + 
    (hints_any | participant) + (1 | cue),
  family = binomial(),
  data = exp1
)
x2 <- glmer(
  test_accuracy ~ hints_any + 
    (hints_any | participant) + (1 | cue),
  family = binomial(),
  data = exp2
)
x3 <- glmer(
  test_accuracy ~ hints_any + 
    (hints_any | participant) + (1 | cue),
  family = binomial(),
  data = exp3
)

list(x1, x2, x3) %>% 
  map(~tidy(., "fixed")) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  filter(term!="(Intercept)") %>% 
  # knitr::kable(digits = c(1,2,2,2,3)) %>% 
  glue_data("b = {round(estimate, 2)}, z = {round(statistic, 2)}, p = {round(p.value, 3)}")
```

# Meta-analysis

## Waiting time

```{r}
library(metafor)
# Refit experiment 1 with median split curiosity
exp1_ma <- exp1 %>% 
  group_by(participant) %>% 
  mutate(
    curiosity = factor(
      curiosity > median(curiosity, na.rm = TRUE),
      labels = c("Not curious", "Curious")
      )
    ) %>% 
  ungroup()
fit_1_time_ma <- lmer(
  choice_rt ~ curiosity + (curiosity | participant) + (curiosity | cue),
  data = exp1_ma
)
time_ma_terms <- bind_rows(
  tidy(fit_1_time_ma, "fixed"),
  tidy(fit_2_time, "fixed"),
  tidy(fit_3_time, "fixed"),
  .id = "Experiment"
) %>% 
  mutate(Experiment = paste0("Experiment ", Experiment)) %>% 
  filter(term=="curiosityCurious")

time_ma_fit <- rma(
  yi = time_ma_terms$estimate, 
  sei = time_ma_terms$std.error,
  slab = time_ma_terms$Experiment
)
png(filename = "Time-ma.png", height = 3.4, width = 5, units = "in", res = 360)
forest(
  time_ma_fit, 
  xlab = "Effect size", 
  mlab = "Meta-analytic estimate", 
  cex = .75
  )
dev.off()
```

## p hints

```{r}
fit_1_hints_a_ma <- glmer(
  hints_any ~ curiosity + (curiosity | participant) + (1 | cue),
  family = binomial(),
  data = exp1_ma
)

hints_a_ma_terms <- bind_rows(

  tidy(fit_2_hints_a, "fixed"),

) %>%
```

## Final recall

```{r}
fit_1_test <- glmer(
  test_accuracy ~ curiosity + (curiosity | participant) + (1 | cue),
  family = binomial(),
  data = exp1_ma
)

recall_ma_terms <- bind_rows(
  tidy(fit_1_test, "fixed"),
  tidy(fit_2_test, "fixed"),
  tidy(fit_3_test, "fixed"),
  .id = "Experiment"
) %>% 
  mutate(Experiment = paste0("Experiment ", Experiment)) %>% 
  filter(term=="curiosityCurious")

recall_ma_fit <- rma(
  yi = recall_ma_terms$estimate, 
  sei = recall_ma_terms$std.error,
  slab = recall_ma_terms$Experiment
)
png(filename = "Recall-ma.png", height = 3.4, width = 5, units = "in", res = 360)
forest(
  recall_ma_fit, xlab = "Effect size", 
  mlab = "Meta-analytic estimate", 
  cex = .75
  )
dev.off()
```

## Combined plot

```{r}
png(filename = "Combined-ma.png", height = 6, width = 6, units = "in", res = 360)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
forest(
  time_ma_fit, xlab = "Effect size", 
  cex = .75, main = "'Waiting time'"
  )
forest(
  hints_a_ma_fit, xlab = "Effect size", 
  cex = .75, main = "p(Asked for hint(s))"
  )
forest(
  hints_b_ma_fit, xlab = "Effect size",
  cex = .75, main = "Number of hints requested"
  )
forest(
  recall_ma_fit, xlab = "Effect size", 
  cex = .75, main = "p(Final recall)"
  )
dev.off()
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
